sections.Intro: The active principle of the medulla of the suprarenal gland, (adrenalium) is employed as a chemical messenger, which speeds up the oxidative metabolism, regulates blood pressure by its action on the sympathetic system. Its action is very prompt. For homeopathic use the 2x to 6x attenuations. Adrenalin or Epinephrin, the active principle of the medulla of the suprarenal gland, is employed as a local astringent and haemostatic and cardiac and vasomotor stimulant. It is indicated in a variety of diseases, such as:—Graves' disease, Goitre, Tabes, Shock, Epistaxis, Albuminuria, Congestion of lungs, Asthma, Hay-fever, and Addison's disease, etc.
sections.Description: Its action is very prompt. Its main action is stimulation of the sympathetic nerve endings, notably the splanchnic, resulting in a marked contraction of the muscular coat of the blood vessels and a very rapid rise of blood pressure. In homeopathy, it is indicated in many diseases, especially those having a sudden onset and high blood pressure.
